page.eyebrow: PoC · video totem on the wall
page.title: Watch the lesson on the room wall
page.lead: A room of a fictional English school for Brazilians, with YouTube video totems on the walls. Walk up to a totem and press E (or tap Watch, or click it): the video opens in full screen, with only the basics of the environment, and the scene stops drawing until you close it.
page.keysMove: W/S or ↑/↓: walk · A/D or ←/→: turn
page.keysInteract: Near a totem: E watches the video · Esc closes the video
page.keysClick: Click or tap a totem to watch
page.keysTouch: On touch: the corner joystick walks and turns; Watch opens the video

failed.unavailable: This video is not available: it was removed, is private or the address changed. Let your institution know.
failed.embedBlocked: This video cannot be shown here: its owner does not allow it outside YouTube, or it was removed or made private. Let your institution know.
failed.noResponse: The video did not load. The network may be blocking YouTube, or the connection dropped.
